instruction: A cinematic still medium shot depicts an indoor scene by a large window overlooking a hazy winter cityscape. On the left, the bearded man in the white dress shirt (R2) stands in profile, holding a red cup. On the right, the woman in the white button-down shirt (R1) stands in profile, holding a brown paper cup in her left hand while raising her right hand in a stop gesture, her expression skeptical. They stand opposite each other as she pauses the conversation. Soft, cool daylight from the window casts a muted tone over the scene.
elements: R1 raises her right hand in a stop gesture toward R2
R1 skeptically pauses the conversation rather than R2 doing so
R2 holds a red cup while facing R1
